notes.title: Demo is ready now!
notes.content:
Good new! Coin War Demo is now available on Steam! Search for Coin War Demo on Steam and add it to your library. Two chapters and one deck are available. Hope you will enjoy this demo!
Join our Discord to hear more and give us feedback: https://discord.gg/WvFq867q

notes.title: [Roadmap] Hello World! Coin War is now on Steam and demo is coming soon!
notes.content:
Welcome, card game lovers! Demo will be available within 1 week. Looking forward to your play and feedback. While waiting for the demo, I'm thrilled to unveil the development roadmap for Coin War!

Phase 1: Core System Overhaul
After the demo is launched, I will adjust the cards and enemies based on the feedback from the game in order to make sure your battles should feel both challenging and rewarding.

Phase 2: System Expansion
I will add events, merchants' goods, relics, side quests into Coin War, making it a living world full of surprises and rewards! 

Phase 3: A Complete Expedition
All chapters will be unlocked. You can encounter more enemies!

Phase 4: Renovated World
Game's art will be upgraded. Better UI and scene art!

Phase 5: Two More Decks
Two decks with new mechanics and combat styles will be added to the game.

Thank you for trying or wishlisting Coin War. This is of great significance to the development of Coin War. I look forward to seeing you next time.
